F1 answer.purpose: Answer the guardian's own question about their child under the enrolment contract

F2 draft.purpose: Draft that answer; the model provider acts as a processor for F1

F3 log.purpose: Check reply quality and investigate complaints, without sensitive data

F4 cache.purpose: Avoid repeated model calls for identical prompts

F5 offers.purpose: Send offers only to guardians who agreed, with a way to stop
